integrity: Exact finite-field enumeration for extension degrees 1 through 10, symbolic smoothness reduction, functional-equation reconstruction, and modular irreducibility check; code provided. Independent checks not performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact Weil polynomial and base-field simplicity concern the specified characteristic-three model only; its plane-filling construction, smoothness, genus and ordinarity already occur in earlier work. No absolute simplicity or exhaustive uniqueness of arithmetic tables is claimed. Possible unindexed prior zeta-function computations remain a priority risk.
title: The complete Weil polynomial and simple ordinary Jacobian of a plane-filling sextic over \(\mathbb F_3\)
